title: Chilli Cheese & Balsamic Caramelised Onion Grilled Sandwich
intro: Crispy, buttery bread, gooey melted cheese, a little chilli heat and sweet, tangy balsamic caramelised onions. Basically, grilled cheese got a glow-up.

items: 80–100 g cheese (mozzarella, cheddar or a mix)
½ tsp chilli flakes (adjust to taste)
Salt and black pepper, to taste

method: Heat the olive oil or butter in a pan. Add the sliced onions with a pinch of salt and cook on low heat until soft and golden.
Add the balsamic vinegar and cook for another 1–2 minutes until the onions are sticky, glossy and caramelised.
Butter the bread slices. Layer one slice with cheese, the balsamic onions, chilli flakes and more cheese. Top with the second slice.
Grill in a pan over low-medium heat until golden and crispy on both sides and the cheese is melted.
Slice in half and admire the cheese pull before taking a bite.
tips: Low and slow is the secret to properly caramelised onions. And grate your own cheese if you want the dreamiest melt!
